svg.title: From divisor relations to a finite count
svg.desc: Divisor relations yield integral-group modular cycles by polynomial filters and lattice transport. Residue evaluation retains two prime-power losses. Equality of all evaluations implies global equality modulo powers by Kummer detection. The injective image is bounded by arithmetic homology rank and torsion.

g.text: From divisor relations to a finite count
Polynomial filters, lattice transport and prisms
Modular cycles at integral matrix ranks
Evaluate at every eligible residue field
Retain the homological and interpolation prime-power losses
Kummer detection makes the map injective on the separated family.
Homological capacity bounds the number of classes
r = number of complex places; torsion at the explicit stable rank
The remaining modulus factor must be canceled by a separate arithmetic theorem.
